findings.current: *“By the way, do you happen to know someone here named Hongcheon?”*
findings.defect: The draft misreads 이 가에 as “here” and omits Hongcheon’s surname, Yi, changing the person’s stated identity.
findings.rationale: 이 가 identifies the Yi family or surname, while 홍천 is explicitly presented as the person’s given name.
findings.replacement: *“By the way, do you happen to know a man surnamed Yi whose given name is Hongcheon?”*
findings.source: ‘아, 그건 그렇고 이 가에 홍천이라는 함자를 쓰시는 분을 알고 계시오?’

findings.current: Together with those who had been with me—and those I wanted to remain with in the future.
findings.defect: The draft changes a single group defined by two linked qualities into potentially separate groups and shifts the first quality from present companionship to past companionship.
findings.rationale: The same 이들 are both currently with Taekyung and people he wants to continue being with.
findings.replacement: Together with those who were by my side—and whom I wanted by my side in the future.
findings.source: 나와 함께하는, 그리고 앞으로도 함께하고 싶은 이들과 함께.

findings.current: There is precedent, and decades of resentment over how the spoils were distributed after the war must have accumulated.
findings.defect: “Spoils” narrows 논공행상 to material plunder, omitting the allocation of honors and rewards according to wartime merit.
findings.rationale: 논공행상 refers broadly to evaluating contributions and distributing honors and rewards, not merely dividing spoils.
findings.replacement: There is precedent, and decades of resentment over the postwar allocation of honors and rewards must have accumulated.
findings.source: 전례도 있거니와 종전 후 논공행상에 대한 불만이 수십 년간 쌓여 있을 테니까.

findings.current: 1. Hey, we’re spilling the tea on Dark Heaven. These guys are seriously fucking crazy, so listen up.
findings.defect: “Spilling the tea” imposes a culturally specific, dated gossip idiom that makes the warning sound like rumor-sharing rather than an irreverently compressed account.
findings.rationale: 썰 푼다 casually means telling or recounting a story; it does not specifically invoke gossip or secret revelations.
findings.replacement: 1. Hey, let me tell you about Dark Heaven. These guys are seriously fucking crazy, so listen up.
findings.source: 1. 야야, 암천 썰 푼다. 이거 진짜 미친놈들이니까 잘 들어 봐.

findings.current: The unorthodox forces that had maintained their bloodlines to this day had survived because they had sided with the orthodox faction during the Great Faction War.
findings.defect: “Maintained their bloodlines” incorrectly makes 명맥 biological or genealogical; it refers to the continued existence of the unorthodox forces.
findings.rationale: 명맥을 이어 가다 means to preserve a group, practice, or tradition’s continued existence.
findings.replacement: The unorthodox forces still around today owed their survival to siding with the orthodox faction during the Great Faction War.
findings.source: 지금까지 명맥을 이어 가고 있는 사파 세력은 정마대전 당시 정파의 편에 섰기 때문에 살아남을 수 있었다.

findings.current: In the end, we accepted the government’s proposal and cracked down on their own people.
findings.defect: “Cracked down on” softens the violent, colloquial 족친 and understates that the Hubei dark-path forces were wiped out.
findings.rationale: 족치다 is a rough expression for violently beating, destroying, or eliminating someone; the surrounding passage confirms that the group was uprooted.
findings.replacement: In the end, we accepted the government’s proposal and wiped out their own people.
findings.source: 결국 우리가 관부의 제안을 받아들여서 자기네 식구 족친 거잖아요.

findings.current:
“First. Since the end of the war, the unorthodox Murim has been fractured into countless pieces. They should be considered rivals, not family. We took this opportunity to uproot the dark-path figures in Hubei, whose numbers had become unusually large. Another unorthodox faction will fill the vacant space. It is a new opportunity.”

“…”
findings.defect: The draft drops the exclamation mark and turns Taekyung’s startled realization into a neutral silence.
findings.rationale: The source punctuation marks a sharp reaction to Jin Wikyung’s explanation, not merely a pause.
findings.replacement:
“First. Since the end of the war, the unorthodox Murim has been fractured into countless pieces. They should be considered rivals, not family. We took this opportunity to uproot the dark-path figures in Hubei, whose numbers had become unusually large. Another unorthodox faction will fill the vacant space. It is a new opportunity.”

“…!”

summary: One identity omission, one altered relationship beat, and several localized fidelity and register issues.
